title: Fix session timeout on report export
description: Exporting a large report can outlast the session and return users to the sign-in page without a download.

title: Add keyboard navigation to issue list
description: Allow users to move between issue rows and open a selected issue with the keyboard.

title: Correct timezone in activity timestamps
description: Activity timestamps currently display one hour ahead for users in India during daylight-saving conversions.

title: Document issue triage checklist
description: Write a concise checklist for reviewing new bug reports before assigning them to a sprint.

title: Prevent duplicate form submission
description: Disable the submit action while a request is pending to avoid creating duplicate records on slow connections.

title: Add saved filters for project leads
description: Let project leads quickly reuse common combinations of status, assignee, and priority filters.

title: Resolve blank avatar on team page
description: Show the initials fallback when a team member profile has no uploaded avatar.

title: Build sprint capacity summary
description: Provide a compact view of committed story points by assignee for the current sprint.

title: Update onboarding guide screenshots
description: Replace outdated screenshots in the onboarding guide after the navigation refresh.

title: Fix issue search ignoring hyphens
description: Searching for an issue ID with a hyphen currently returns no results unless the punctuation is removed.

title: Add release notes preview
description: Show a preview of release notes before a project lead publishes them to the team.

title: Investigate intermittent board refresh
description: Identify why the board sometimes reloads after a user returns from another browser tab.

title: Improve contrast for priority labels
description: Adjust priority label colors to meet accessible contrast expectations in both light and dark themes.

title: Add assignee workload indicator
description: Show a small workload indicator when selecting an assignee for a new issue.

title: Fix narrow-screen detail panel overflow
description: Keep the issue detail panel within the viewport on small laptop and tablet widths.
